L12: top-up at three halls, and the delay that decides how well each works.
L4: the menu-rotation loop, closed end to end by a loud complaint with a route.
L17: kitchen competence relieves the symptom each morning, so the fundamental fix never gets pressure.
L13: the core chain. A flat booking meets a fixed ratio; the quality branch is dashed because its closing link is not evidenced.
L14: shortage is loud and surplus is silent, so the ratio can ratchet upward. The dashed link is a candidate.
L2: Skip Meal. The student link is confirmed and near zero; the kitchen link is in open conflict.
